newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers higher despite weak cargo.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers higher despite weak cargo.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were quoted slightly higher on Tuesday on anticipation that a local trading company might emerge to support prices.

Despite the weak cargo market, some suppliers are expecting the local buyer, which pushed up cargo prices in early last week, to bid up prices again. "Bunker prices are in general in a downtrend but some suppliers are not willing to cut prices, counting on the local buyer," said one trader.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $98-$99 per tonne and 180-cst was at $105-$106. MDO and gas oil were at around $195-$198 and $210-$215 respectively. - Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
